paragraphs.text: The feast gets announced first: somehow wins — ah! — this sweet worship-high-feast, since nectar-sap-taste tears even give amply. Dealings success-giving, all, whose vanguard is Your worship. Lovers, Thee-made, themselves ripe attainments. Ever, in all states, at once, all-shaped: they worship restless, and they are my gods. Touch-Thee-feast, ripe by scorning thought-strain: worship’s rule, so famed, be mine ever. Lovers’ evenness-pith-equinox-tide, ever: by Thy-state-sap-nectar-sap, their ever-worship. Whose start-and-end are not, nor time-rank, Ruler: worship-selved is that deed; its doers, Thy partakers, merely. BrahmA-and-first ones even, rulers, fortune-sharers: in whose dream even, swoon even, stands Thy worship-feast. Mutterers, offerers, bathers, thinkers — and not barely: lovers’ Thee-worship, ah, as-far, when, then. Tasting Your worship-nectar-joy-wedding, glad, ever: mid Indra-and-first, ay, BrahmA-chiefs — is who their match? At Thy worship-high-feast, sole-born of world-churn: what won is won, some; lovers alone ken it.

Then the feast gets entered. In Thy knowing-made seat standing, by six-and-thirty-principle-deeds: by body-speech-mind-stirs and the rest, worship I Thee ever, All. Glad in Thy-worship-woven-clinging-wedding, of me: fare, time, all, ay, endless. This I pray. Greed for Thy-worship-nectar-sap-feasting: All! Wax day on day, and ever fruit, for me. In Thine ocean, brimmed with world-play-nectar-one-sap: Thee, high-souled, worshiping may I sit, ever. Ever plain by all-hankering-knot-severing: may mind be laid before Thee by lovers, sweet, in Thy worship-rule. Standing upon these sense-fields, sense-plays of lovers send: for Thy-worship-sake, nectar-wine. Lovers, love-surge-great-heat-helpless-souled: what other freedom-cause, but drowning in Thy-worship-nectar? Ever, Thy-foot-honoring-nectar-drink-high-feast: my Thy-grace-one-winning cause, may it avail. May I feel, Ruler, deed by deed, wink by wink: Thy-worship-nectar-drink-frenzy-taste-high-glee. Seen-fruited indeed is lovers’ Thy-worship-high-venture: at once, unthinkable joy they taste. While unwon, Thy-worship-high-feast: while, untasted I deem a speck even of joy’s hoard. Lovers’, without sense-hunt-shine-strain even: strain-free-ripe, Thy seat-standing in worship is born.

Then the feast deepens. Naught to win is there for lovers, nor aught scarce to them. Merely roam they: Thy-worship-wine-frenzy-mad. Ah! love-heavy-open-hearted: love, Ruler! Toward Thee: praised, the worship-rule, somehow — by begging unstained. What beauty is not, what glee not, what thrive not, or else: what freedom not, since this Great God is worshiped? Inward-sporting-clear-fed, Thy love-fed: for Thy-worship’s use be mine this frame. Thy-foot-worship-wedding-bound ever, All: may I be, worlds’ Ruler, alone, free-stirring. Thy-thought-seeing-touch-thirst: of some even, Ruler, is born cool-sweet Thy-worship-high-lake. As Thou alone art the world’s worship-wedding-bowl: so, Ruler, the lover alone is worship-wedding-bowl. Somehow wins, Master: Thy worship-high-feast, where of six-and-thirty principles even churn sports amply. Bow to them, All: whose, by love-nectar-water, hallowed themselves turn Thy worship-gear even. At worship’s start, All: thought on, mantra-laid Thy selfness, in self alone, high, lovers shine with glee — nowhither. By kingdom-winning-and-the-rest-blooming ones at Thy worship-high-feast: with nectar-wine the all-earth is shared out. Worship-nectar-drink-made, whose feasting wink by wink: are they gods? Are they freed? Or whatever folk indeed?

Then the feast gets sealed. By world-turned-worship-gear-guise, weight. Ah! some of lovers and some indeed lightness. From worship-made-glance-toss-churn alone, nectar-upcoming: for lovers; as milk-sea-churn for sky-dwellers. Worship some deem a wish-cow. Nectar-stream-over-sapped, suck the inward-faced others. Lovers’ glance-toss even — this, passing-approved — fetching some within, fattens the worship-high-feast. By love-churn’s force, Ruler, worship in Thee, self-become. Strange: for abjectness’ high fruit. Courtesy-tread is worship, for some, to win Thy feet. For lovers, Thine-one-self-bliss-spread is it. By unbound-mad-love’s unbarred — worship of unjoined-shape even — spread out, it wins a stand in Thee, some. Mind stilled by tasting sweet-love-sap: fallen, beauteous. Kind One: Thou alone, lovely, art worship’s bowl, they say. Brimmed, pure, loving, steady: in Thy worship-rule, Ruler, means be mine. In all-worship’s true-treasury, in Thy worship-work, Ruler: ah! sense-throng’s some fortune unfolds. This prettiness, Ruler: Thine alone, they say, is seen: All-Lord even, by slaves art Thou worshiped and won. From ever-formed or formless, being or even unbeing: may rise, mine, of the praised, Thy worship-high-feast. With lust, anger, pride made offering ever: who worship — bow to them. Of them pleased am I, in truth. Wins, this, Thy-love-sharers’ worship-rule, high: with straws wrought even, with jewels fitted.
